content: LLM confabulation on personal-sensing data is confident-but-wrong pattern generation, not lying — models fill low-signal gaps with statistically plausible narratives and are overconfident about them. Mitigations from the literature: require explicit evidence citations per claim (grounding), separate frequency/recency-based statistics from generated narrative, and calibrate/communicate uncertainty rather than asserting a single confident story (see arXiv 2605.08590 auditing 'epistemic overreach' in LLM-generated personal sensing explanations).
